verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly describe turning Linear/Jira tickets into implemented features and closing the loop with Devin Review/Auto-Fix until PRs are merge-ready, covering the full ticket-to-PR workflow. However, hands-on community testing reports concrete failures — extraneous changes that break other things, inability to undo them, and the tool not actually saving time despite being expensive — directly contradicting the polished end-to-end claim. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarks showing consistent successful PR completion, and resolution of the reported reliability issues.
